commands_used: answer 1. I was freed from the Owing by an order from Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, who wants me at her house there. On the way the tree-minder wants Sithis beard, a grey moss, from the creek below Reed-Sill Weir. 2. Pick the Sithis beard at the marker below Reed-Sill Weir, then continue east to Jal-Veesa. 3. Fight the two young crocodiles, shoot them from the log walk on top of the weir, or sneak past out of their sight. 4. I do not know what the Hist, Jal-Veesa or the Owing really are, or why Vosh-Leera wants me. I could ask people in town.

answer 1. I picked the moss without a fight. Weeltul, tree-minder of Jal-Veesa, wants it at the Hist pool; the Hist is the town great thinking tree. Vosh-Leera also wants me. 2. Go east to Jal-Veesa and bring the beard to Weeltul at the Hist pool. 3. Just travel there; I can also talk to people in town about the Hist and Vosh-Leera. 4. I still do not know why the tree needs the moss, or why Vosh-Leera wants me; I can ask Weeltul and Vosh-Leera.

answer 1. The Hist of Jal-Veesa is sick: dry dark bark, closed scar, cooling egg-pool. Nobody knows why; if it dies no eggs hatch and the town empties. The moss only warmed the pool. 2. Go to Vosh-Leera in her house in Jal-Veesa. 3. Enter her house and talk to her; or first ask Weeltul about the sap, scar, eggs, Umbriel. 4. I do not know what caused the sickness, what Umbriel was, or why Vosh-Leera wants me; I can ask Weeltul and Vosh-Leera.

answer 1. I now work for the Toh-Reel-Ka, the Secret Warriors of the Xeech-Leel who rule the province. Trees are falling sick along the river and they want the cause found. Vosh-Leera freed me because I am a stranger with no kin, so I am cheap and useful as a spy. She paid me 50 gold. 2. Return to Vosh-Leera in her house in Jal-Veesa for a second task. 3. Take the second task, or ask Weeltul more first (sap, scar, eggs, Umbriel). I do not see a way to refuse. 4. I do not know what is making the trees sick, or what the second task is. I am not sure how much of the Toh-Reel-Ka story is true. I can ask Vosh-Leera and Weeltul.

answer I am Tarin, freed from the Owing barge. I fetched Sithis beard from Reed-Sill Weir without fighting the crocodiles and gave it to Weeltul, tree-minder at Jal-Veesa Hist pool. The Hist is sick (dry dark bark, closed scar, cooling egg-pool). The moss only warmed the water. I have its blessing and 50 gold. Vosh-Leera, in her house by the Hist, works for the Toh-Reel-Ka, the secret order of the Xeech-Leel who rule the marsh since the An-Xileel fell. They watch trees after Umbriel (4E 48). Trees are sickening along the river and they want to know why. She picked me because I have no kin. Next: talk to Vosh-Leera again for a second task. Unasked: Weeltul topics on sap, scar, eggs and Umbriel. I do not know the cause of the sickness.
